# anotifier

> anotifier is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), zero-dependency CLI that sends
> notifications when AI coding agents finish a task or need input. It wires into
> each agent's native hook system — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI,
> and any of them inside VS Code — and delivers desktop toasts (Windows/macOS/
> Linux/WSL), phone push via ntfy (Android/iOS, no account), webhooks (Slack,
> Discord, Telegram, any HTTP endpoint), and a terminal bell. Setup is one
> command: `npx anotifier@latest setup`. Config lives at ~/.anotifier/config.json.
> Everything runs locally; nothing is sent anywhere except the channels you
> configure, and phone push is generic text by default.

## Full documentation

- [Complete docs, plain text](https://anotifier.io/llms-full.txt): the entire reference plus every guide and the comparison, as markdown — read this first
- [Docs (HTML)](https://anotifier.io/docs/): install, setup wizard, all 7 CLI commands, every config key with defaults, events, channels, privacy, troubleshooting, FAQ

## Guides (how to get notified when an agent finishes)

- [Claude Code](https://anotifier.io/guides/claude-code-notifications/): built-in terminal setting, Stop/Notification hook, ntfy phone push, anotifier
- [Codex CLI](https://anotifier.io/guides/codex-cli-notifications/): notify command, Stop/PermissionRequest hooks, approval alerts
- [Cursor](https://anotifier.io/guides/cursor-agent-notifications/): completion sound, stop hook in ~/.cursor/hooks.json
- [Gemini CLI](https://anotifier.io/guides/gemini-cli-notifications/): AfterAgent/Notification hooks in ~/.gemini/settings.json
- [All guides](https://anotifier.io/guides/)

## Compared with alternatives

- [anotifier vs code-notify, agent-notify, claude-ntfy-hook, Pushary, AI Done Now, DIY hooks](https://anotifier.io/compare/): agents, channels, platforms, remote approval, price — from each project's own README
